issue_context.title: Grid View should have Rounded Corners
issue_context.body:
Honestly, I think grid view would look better with rounded corners. In the current setup, the video and image thumbnails have straight corners, which don't really match with the design.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/48651837/128200463-4bcc85e1-d16f-4baa-b7ea-63ef6a475b48.png)
